scripts.build: node src/scripts/lint-duplicate-titles.mjs && node src/scripts/lint-missing-images.mjs && node src/scripts/seo-lint-fixer.mjs && astro build && node research/agents/lib/inline-css.mjs && npx pagefind --site dist

scripts.release-prep: npm run generate-llms && npm run build
